coordinate_and_units.world_x_axis: +x is forward (away from torso); +y is left; +z is up
coordinate_and_units.err_x0_definition: error[0] = land_x_m = x_land - x_target (m) from evaluate(command_warm)
coordinate_and_units.sign_check: err_x0 > 0 means forward overshoot (+x), requiring negative dvx = -err_x0 / flight to pull landing backward toward target[0]

parameter_justification.err_x0_trigger_threshold_m: Native cascade.py:521 already applies a built-in ballistic step clipped to +/-0.20 m/s, which absorbs up to 0.20 * 0.53 = 0.106 m (106 mm) of forward landing error. Setting the trigger threshold to 0.12 m (120 mm) strictly above the native 106 mm reach avoids disturbing normal warm-starts while catching large forward mismatches.

trial_budget_accounting_note: In a native cascade.py implementation, the rule reuses evaluate(command) at line 475 (0 extra trials when not triggered, +1 trial when triggered). Because this experiment does not modify src/jugglebot/humanoid/cascade.py, the external wrapper executes 1 live probe on a clean fork and cannot hard-deduct 1 trial from cascade.py's internal loop counters; both probe_trials and planner_trials are reported separately and summed as total_trials.
